description: Cheapest AI model that can do your job. Describe the task (or list needed features: tools, json, reasoning, vision...), expected input/output tokens and a quality level (budget/balanced/best); get the cheapest suitable models across all major providers with estimated USD cost per call and per 1,000 calls, from live prices. Price: $0.01 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.

limit.description: How many ranked models to return.

minContext.description: Minimum context window (default: input + output tokens).

needs.description: Comma list of required features (added to any the task implies): tools, json, reasoning, vision, audio, files, web-search.

providers.description: Only these providers, comma separated (e.g. anthropic,openai).

quality.description: budget, balanced or best. If a task is given, the AI's judgement is used unless you set this to something other than balanced.

task.description: What the model must do, in plain words. An AI reads it to work out the needed features and quality.

name: ai-models-pick

candidates.description: Suitable models, cheapest first, each with estimatedCostPerCallUsd.

recommended.description: Cheapest suitable model, with estimatedCostPerCallUsd and estimatedCostPer1000CallsUsd.

requirements.description: What was required (from your inputs and, if given, the AI's reading of the task).

title: AI models pick ($0.01)
